title: South Carolina Code of Laws Title 12, Chapter 6 - South Carolina Income Tax Act
source_id: S.C. Code Ann. tit. 12, ch. 6 (secs. 12-6-10 to 12-6-5600)
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 12 chapter index (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title12.php): title 'Title 12 - Taxation', chapter row 'CHAPTER 6 - SOUTH CAROLINA INCOME TAX ACT' with no [REPEALED] marker; then fetched https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t12c006.php, whose heading reads 'CHAPTER 6 / South Carolina Income Tax Act', with Article 1 (Adoption of Internal Revenue Code-Definitions), Article 5 (Tax Rates and Imposition), Article 9 (Taxable Income Calculation), Article 13 (Nonresident and Part-Year Resident Individuals) and Article 25 (Credits), running from SECTION 12-6-10 to SECTION 12-6-5600. Currency: current through the 2025 Session.
notes: The substantive personal income tax. Employer wage withholding is in a separate chapter, Title 12, Chapter 8 (Income Tax Withholding, secs. 12-8-10 to 12-8-2040, with Article 5 'Withholding Required' and Article 9 'Procedure for Withholding on Wages'), verified in force at https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t12c008.php on the same currency; a human encoding withholding rules specifically should take ch. 12-8 rather than ch. 12-6. Federal withholding is 26 U.S.C. ch. 24.
